test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**explore**" means to investigate, examine, or discuss in detail. (अन्वेषण करना)
 
• In this context,** "explore" **appropriately fills the blank, indicating that literature allows us to investigate and understand different emotions and perspectives.
 
• The other options: "**explain**," "**exploit**," and "**exclaim**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Through various forms like novels, poems, and plays, literature allows us to explore__ different emotions and perspectives.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Explain (समझाना)**: means to make an idea, situation, or problem clear to someone by describing it in more detail.
 
• **Exploit (शोषण करना)**: means to make full use of and derive benefit from a resource, often unethically.
 
• **Exclaim (आवाज़ उठाना)**: means to cry out suddenly, especially in surprise, anger, or pain.
